name: render_quads_flat
describe: Per-quad flat-lighting vertex emit to a DefaultVertexFormats.BLOCK buffer (28 ints/quad): addVertexData, putBrightness4(brightnessIn x4), optional putColorMultiplier (tint color and/or diffuse), putPosition(d0,d1,d2). World-dependent brightness+tint snapshot as inputs. Golden captured live via NetheriteMod 'capture_quadsflat'.
